# wait-becomes-later-departure

Synthetic. One stop, Bognor, between 12:00 and 13:00; the day starts at 09:00 at home. About 19
minutes away on the estimate, so a 09:00 departure would arrive at 09:19 and wait 2 hours 41
minutes. The plan reports the arrival at 12:00 and the departure from home at 11:41 (§6.5: "waits
become later departures"), never a wait at the seller's.
